title: Takes a long time to warm your coffee, too long....
text:
Takes a long time to warm your coffee, too long..... We have tried 3 mug warmers on Amazon. Here is a scale to articulate our findings:

10 - This is off the boiler hot, cannot sip.
8 - Still very hot, but you can manage little sips without burning yourself.
6 - No longer very hot, simply hot, and you can take big sips or gulps.
4 - No longer hot, but warm
2 - Barely warm, moving toward lukewarm.

This Misby version is a disappointing 4 on my scale above, and it takes several hours to get 4. With the metal plate at the bottom for heat induction, I was hopeful for this warmer, but I think they simply made the mug too thick. The best version I've tried so far is one made by IWOXS. That one can get to a 6 on scale in 30 minutes: https://www.amazon.com/review/R11A7OF8YQYR6C/ref=cm_cr_srp_d_rdp_perm?ie=UTF8&ASIN=B08CXJVH1V

All vine items, no dog in this fight. Just my honest opinion. 2 Stars.
